title: The BoJ's Equity Bet Is Paying for QE Exit
standfirst: The dividend from the Bank of Japan's over-¥100 trn equity ETF portfolio covers what it loses on its bonds. The same portfolio is the only channel through which the exit can break the Bank.
_note: Titles, source notes and y-axis labels are the TITLE / SOURCE / YLABEL constants of each chart script in the JMA chart library, copied verbatim. Data cut from the library master CSVs per the exhibit ledger in the report record (30.Reports/2026-08/2026-08-12-boj-equity-bet-sub.md). Charts 9-11 were built for the report and held out of the published post for length; they sit behind a section header. All engine figures are on the distribution-growth dividend basis of 2026-08-11.
_series_order: Scenario-path charts carry one base_case column holding the actual history then the Main forecast, split solid/dashed by the phase column; the 2.0% and accelerated columns begin at 2026-07 seeded with the last actual value so the lines connect, as the published PNGs prepend it. No two series share a history column, so the shared-history colour trap does not arise.

charts.title: Majority of BoJ's assets are low-yielding
charts.source: Sources: BoJ, JMA estimates. * denote yields as of FY2025.
charts.note: The published chart is a horizontal bar chart; the page presents the same seven balance-sheet lines, and the ETF-at-market memo line below the rule, as a table so every figure and note is readable. Yields marked FY2025 are the realised figures carried forward, as the chart's asterisks denote.

charts.title: 80% of BoJ's funding costs move with policy rate
charts.source: Sources: BoJ, JMA estimates. * denote yields as of FY2025.
charts.note: ¥506.8trn of liabilities (79.2%) reprice with the policy rate; ¥132.7trn (20.8%) do not — the split the published chart colours.

charts.title: Funding cost passed JGB income in FY2025
charts.source: Source: BoJ, JMA. Dashed lines are JMA forecast.
charts.note: Fiscal years: 2020 means FY2020. Interest paid is the broad total — reserves, foreign central-bank deposits and repos. FY2025 is the crossing the title dates: income ¥2.52trn against ¥3.09trn paid. The forecast leg is the base case.

charts.title: Low-yielding JGBs take a decade to roll off the BoJ
charts.source: Source: BoJ, MoF, JMA. BoJ holdings at July 2026, by yield at purchase.
charts.note: The FY2036 bar is ‘2036 and later’. The published chart merges the master CSV’s 0.25–0.50% and 0.50–1.00% bands into one 0.25–1.00% band; the page follows it, and adds the total-maturing line for hover convenience — the published chart carries the stack only. The coral band — bonds bought at negative yields, ¥37trn — is still on the book into the 2030s.

charts.title: Policy rate scenarios
charts.source: Source: JMA. Dashed lines are forecasts.
charts.note: Actual to July 2026, then the three JMA scenarios: base case to a 1.5% terminal in March 2027; the 2.0% case on a gradual pace; the accelerated case hiking every three months to 2.5% by January 2028.

charts.title: 10-year JGB yield scenarios
charts.source: Source: JMA. Dashed lines are forecasts.
charts.note: The 10-year ends 2029 at 3.13% in the base case, 3.61% in the 2.0% case and 4.06% accelerated — it passes 4% only when the Bank is behind the curve.

charts.title: BoJ portfolio P/L: losses as the policy rate rises to 2.0%
charts.source: Source: JMA. Bars are the economic result, before any provision release.
charts.note: Economic result (経常利益) before any provision release. Base case +0.69 / +0.58 / +2.04; the 2.0% case loses 0.44 in FY2027; the accelerated case loses 1.78 then 1.11.

charts.title: Reserves to decline by 50% by FY2028
charts.source: Source: BoJ, JMA estimates. Figures are end of FY. Dotted bars are estimates.
charts.note: ¥561trn at end-FY2023, when the exit began; ¥282trn at end-FY2028 — halved. The published chart draws the estimates as dotted bars; on this page they render faded, the builder’s standard mark for a value not yet measured.

charts.section: Built for the report, held out of the post
charts.section_note: Three charts produced for this research that did not make the published article, which was at Substack’s length limit. Same data discipline as the rest of the page.
charts.title: 30-year JGB yield scenarios
charts.source: Source: JMA. Dashed lines are forecasts.
charts.note: The 30-year ends 2029 at 3.80% in the base case, 4.31% in the 2.0% case and 4.81% accelerated — rising toward 5% only in a clear behind-the-curve case.

charts.title: Remittance to public coffer drops to zero as rates rise
charts.source: Source: JMA. Annual payments from the BoJ to the national treasury.
charts.note: Three-year totals FY2026-28: ¥2.74trn in the base case, ¥0.80trn in the 2.0% case, ¥0.38trn accelerated — with two of the three years paying nothing in the accelerated case. The cost of the exit surfaces here, not in a reported loss.

charts.title: A fiscal crisis pushes the BoJ into sustained loss
charts.source: Source: JMA. Economic result before provision release. Stagflation: 2.5% policy rate, index -50%, distributions -40%, from FY2027.
charts.note: The only scenario in the research where the ¥7.5trn provision is exhausted: losses of 3.21 / 2.80 / 1.48 across FY2027-29, and a first reported loss of ¥0.04trn in FY2029. The gap between the two series mixes the rate path with the equity shock; the 2.5% path with dividends intact runs -1.78 / -1.11 / +0.49.
